provenance: The sections a technical design is expected to carry, so a thin template still offers a usable checklist. Reference data: changed by a pull request, never at runtime.

sections.name: Context and scope
sections.summary: What the feature is, what it is not, and the decision this design serves.

sections.name: High-level design
sections.summary: The services, stores and boundaries involved, and how the feature moves through them.

sections.name: Low-level design
sections.summary: Per repository: the modules, classes and interfaces that change, and how.

sections.name: Sequence diagrams
sections.summary: The call order for each main path, including the failure paths.

sections.name: Data model and database diagrams
sections.summary: Entities, their relationships, what is stored where, and the migrations needed.

sections.name: API contracts
sections.summary: The operations added or changed, their shapes, and what already exists.

sections.name: Integrations and dependencies
sections.summary: What this relies on from other teams and third parties, and what it must ask for.

sections.name: Security and privacy
sections.summary: Authentication, authorisation, the personal data involved, and how it is protected.

sections.name: Non-functional requirements
sections.summary: Throughput, latency, availability and the limits the design is built to.

sections.name: Monitoring and alerting
sections.summary: What is measured, what is alerted on, and what a person does when it fires.

sections.name: Test approach
sections.summary: What is covered at which level, and what the evidence of done looks like.

sections.name: Rollout and rollback
sections.summary: How this reaches production, behind what flag, and how it is taken back out.

sections.name: Traceability matrix
sections.summary: Every task against the PRD lines, compliance and repos behind it. Built from the analysis, not drafted.

sections.name: Risks
sections.summary: What could go wrong, how likely, and what reduces it.

sections.name: Open questions
sections.summary: What the inputs do not answer, and who can answer it.
